items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Max would call me – Max Gordon. I’d go over there and work with him.

ctx.x: That was – talk about some of the other people that – beyond the musicians’ circle – well, first of all, when did musicians start to come to the Lower East Side?

This is what I was saying. They started migrating down that way when the scene began to evolve down that way, because then another joint opened up over further, the Tin Palace or some other place, and another place somewhere else. Then sometimes I’d go across and work at the Vanguard. Max would call me – Max Gordon. I’d go over there and work with him. So Slug’s became a real spot.
Was the Five Spot part of that? The Dome part of that?
